events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $1.09 (model confidence 0.82)
events.body:
RydeTAXI is metered, so extra kilometres enter the fare directly and RD-2 governs: any off-route segment not excused by RD-3/RD-4/RD-5 is refundable at the per-km rate [F1][F6][RD-1][RD-2]. One off-route segment exists: 09:49–09:52, 2.15 km driven where the optimal route covers 1.38 km, +0.77 km [F3][RD-1].

RD-4 does not exempt it: no traffic incident was recorded near the route in the trip window [F12], and the two speed-band facts (band 4, 30–39 km/h) are only corroborative, not standalone exemption, and in any case they concern the AYE and CTE, not the replaced stretch [F10][F11][F12][RD-4(a)][RD-4(b)]. Weather was fair, so no other "reasonable cause" appears [F13][RD-4(c)].

RD-5 does not exempt it either. Consent must be a rider message sent before the segment started (09:49:15), agreeing to a road or area the driver named before leaving the optimal route [F3][RD-5]. The chat record is complete and fully timestamped and contains a single message, at 09:35: "I'll find you at the lobby, I am in a red jacket" — a pickup arrangement (a locator), not agreement to any route [F7][F8][RD-5]. The only claim of agreement or rerouting is the driver's own statement, written after the trip, which under G11 is not consent [F9][RD-5]. RD-3 is not engaged: no rider-named stop appears in the chat, and no stop was measured in the segment [F3][F7][RD-3(a)].

Amount: the non-exempt segment's extra distance is 0.77 km [F3]; the trip's per-km rate is distance fare ÷ distance = $17.47 ÷ 12.4 km = $1.4089/km, applied by the trace as $1.4100/km [F6][RD-2]. 0.77 km × $1.41/km = $1.0857 → $1.09. The remaining +0.83 km gap between the billed excess (1.6 km, $2.30) and this segment is map-matching residual and is not refunded [F1][F4][RD-2].

RD-6 does not apply: the driver has no prior upheld route dispute in 90 days (route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0), so the case is not "repeated" and no account flag is added [F15][RD-6]. Safety screen: the chat is a pickup locator, the complaint is about routing and fare, and the driver's statement is a bare denial; no threat, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation appears, so no escalation [F7][F9][SAFE-1][SAFE-2]. Refund to be issued as a Ryde voucher per NS-7 [NS-7].
